maintain.ne: FAQ बुलेटिन अपडेटसँगै राखिन्छ। मौसम, सडक, उद्धार, नाम, कोष, हेल्पलाइन र एलपीजीका अंक यहाँ लेखिँदैनन् — सोध्नुहोस् प्यानलले ताजा फाइल पढ्छ।
maintain.en: This FAQ is maintained with bulletin updates. Weather, road, rescue, name, fund, helpline, and LPG figures are not stored here — Ask reads the latest files.

static.ne: मौसम चेतावनी प्रकाशित DHM फाइलबाट आउँछ। सोध्नुहोस्ले DHM साइट आफै स्क्र्याप गर्दैन।
static.en: The weather alert comes from the published DHM file. Ask does not scrape the DHM site.

q.en: Where does the weather answer come from?

static.ne: सडक खण्ड सडक विभागको प्रकाशित सूचीबाट आउँछ। ताजा खण्ड सोध्दा त्यही फाइल पढिन्छ।
static.en: Road sections come from the Department of Roads list published on this site. A fresh question reads that file again.

q.en: What is the source for roads?

static.ne: उद्धार, मृतक, सम्पर्कविहीन र उपचारका अंक प्रकाशित NDRRMA बोर्डबाट आउँछन्। यहाँ ती अंक लेखिँदैनन्।
static.en: Rescue, death, uncontacted, and treatment figures come from the published NDRRMA board. They are not written into this FAQ.

q.en: Where do rescue figures come from?
How do I search a name?

static.ne: नाम प्रकाशित सूचीमा खोजिन्छ। मिल्दो नाम च्याटमा लेखिँदैन। अटो-फेच NDRRMA नाममा मात्र हो।
static.en: Names are looked up in the published list. Matches are not written in the chat. Auto-fetch is NDRRMA names only.

q.en: Where does the name list come from?
What is in the relief fund?

static.ne: कोषका अंक प्रकाशित राहत बोर्ड (अर्थ मन्त्रालय, NCHL, फोनपे) बाट आउँछन्। FAQ मा ती रकम लेखिँदैनन्।
static.en: Fund figures come from the published relief board (Ministry of Finance, NCHL, Fonepay). Those amounts are not stored in the FAQ.

q.en: What is the source for the fund?

static.ne: एलपीजी दैनिक सारांश आपूर्ति पानाको प्रकाशित तालिकाबाट आउँछ। FAQ मा टन लेखिँदैन।
static.en: The LPG daily summary comes from the published table on the supply page. Tonnes are not stored in the FAQ.

q.en: Where does the LPG figure come from?

static.ne: पुँजी बजार सरकारबाट भएका पहल अन्तर्गत छ। पूर्ण कार्ययोजना अलग पानामा छ। अंक त्यही पानाबाट — FAQ मा नयाँ अंक छैन।
static.en: Capital markets sit under government initiatives. The full action plan is its own page. Figures stay on that page — the FAQ does not add new numbers.

static.ne: यो रसुवा–भोटेकोशी बाढीको स्वतन्त्र नागरिक बुलेटिन हो। सरकारी साइट होइन।
static.en: This is an independent citizen bulletin for the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi flood. It is not a government site.

static.ne: सोध्नुहोस् क्लाइन्टमै मिलान गर्छ। मौसम र सडकको लागि छुट्टै सर्भर वा भाषा मोडेल छैन।
static.en: Ask matches on this device. There is no separate server or language model for weather and roads.
